title: Murder on the Orient Express
author: Agatha Christie
summary: A snowdrift stops a luxury train overnight in the Balkans, and a wealthy passenger is found stabbed in his compartment. Detective Hercule Poirot, travelling by chance, has a carriage of suspects with locked stories.
readIf: you want a classic closed-circle murder mystery with a famous, satisfying solution.
skipIf: you want a dark, modern crime novel, since the style is polished and the violence mostly offstage.

pairings.reason: Another of her cleverest closed-circle puzzles, with a much bleaker atmosphere.
A modern, funny cosy mystery that captures the same pleasure of clues and suspects.
A contemporary thriller where a group of people are stuck together with a murderer.
